summary: Delegated provisioner token rotation fails after IdP certificate refresh, blocking RBAC propagation
description:
Issue summary:
Delegated provisioner service intermittently fails to exchange refreshed IdP tokens after a scheduled Okta certificate rotation. When the exchange fails, downstream RBAC updates (SCIM -> internal roles) do not apply for a subset of service accounts, resulting in 403s for runbooks and internal tooling that depend on newly granted entitlements.

Impact:
- Several runbook operations and internal tooling (analytics portal, secrets-runner) report 403 for service-runner accounts issued in the last 12 hours.
- On-call productivity impacted: manual role re-provisioning required for 6 service accounts.
- No reported customer-facing outages; this affects internal automation and scheduled jobs.

Environment:
- prod-us-west cluster running identity-proxy v2.4.1 and provisioner-service v1.8.3
- Okta tenant: redwood-prod (certificate rotation completed 2026-03-09 03:00 UTC)

Steps to reproduce (observed):
1. IdP cert rotation triggers Okta metadata change and IdP thumbprint update at ~03:00 UTC.
2. Provisioner-service attempts delegated token exchange for newly-created service account within 5–15 minutes and receives 401/403 from identity-proxy intermittently.
3. When exchange fails, SCIM propagation completes but authz-cache does not pick up role assignment; affected service accounts continue to be rejected by RBAC checks.

Logs / Observations:
- identity-proxy logs (2026-03-09T03:05:22Z): "WARN token-exchange: token validation failed: cert thumbprint mismatch".
- provisioner-service logs: repeated "token exchange 401" followed by "scim: user created, roles pending cache refresh".
- authz-cache metrics show "cache_misses" spike and "refresh_errors" correlated with the rotation window.
- No schema changes or recent deploys besides scheduled Okta cert rollover.

Temporary workaround applied:
- Manual re-run of role-sync job for affected accounts cleared the 403s for 6 service users.
- On-call has applied a patch to force authz-cache refresh on failed exchanges as a stopgap (deployed to prod-us-west at 2026-03-11 11:30 UTC).

Requested outcome:
- Root-cause analysis of why token exchange fails when Okta rotates certs (thumbprint handling, IdP metadata fetch, or caching TTL).
- Long-term fix to make provisioner-service resilient to IdP key rotation without manual re-syncs.
comments: 2026-03-10 09:12 - Asha Patel (reporter): Initial ticket created after oncall escalated — see attached logs in pastebin (internal).

2026-03-10 10:05 - Marco Ruiz (assignee): Reproduced pattern in staging cluster using a cert swap test; identity-proxy returns 401 when thumbprint cache stale. Added hypothesis: proxy caches IdP thumbprints for 6h; rotation window smaller than cache TTL causes mismatch.
2026-03-11 02:40 - SRE Pager (system): Deployed temporary authz-cache-refresh hook on provisioner-service to bypass stale state — mitigated most failures. Monitoring for recurrence.

2026-03-12 15:22 - Olivia Chen (identity team): Confirmed Okta metadata fetch endpoint returned new cert bundle immediately; suspect our proxy's cache layer didn't hit refresh due to conditional GET headers. Will investigate http-cache behavior in identity-proxy v2.4.1.
investigation_notes: Ran reproducible test in staging by forcing Okta cert rotation; observed identity-proxy thumbprint cache not refreshed until TTL expiry (6h).

identity-proxy code path: fetches idp metadata using If-Modified-Since; Okta metadata endpoint returned 200 OK with new cert but identity-proxy ignored because local cache timestamp considered fresh due to time-skew edge case.

Provisioner-service does not currently retry token exchange on explicit cache-refresh; it treats 401 as terminal for that attempt and moves forward assuming eventual SCIM propagation will reconcile roles.
Authz-cache lacks a fast-path invalidation trigger tied to identity-proxy cert refresh events; role assignments left in "pending" until manual job or cache expiry.
No related recent code deploys in provisioner or identity-proxy preceding the outage window.
resolution:
Workaround: implemented and deployed forced authz-cache refresh on token-exchange failure (prod-us-west) which restored access for affected service accounts.
Long-term fix plan: (1) identity team to update identity-proxy to perform unconditional metadata re-fetch when token-exchange returns 401 due to thumbprint mismatch (PR opened). (2) Add a hook so identity-proxy emits a key-rotation event to the provisioning queue which triggers authz-cache invalidation and immediate role re-evaluation. (3) Add retry logic in provisioner-service for token-exchange where first attempt fails with identity error and include exponential backoff + forced metadata refresh.
Target timeline: PRs for proxy + provisioner by 2026-03-18, staged rollout 2026-03-19, prod rollout 2026-03-21 subject to validation.
